title: Setting deposit limit to zero stops all new deposits
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, new deposit will be stopped (DoS)  **Likelihood:** Low, zero input by mistake or with the intention to cancel/disable deposit limit  ## Description  Deposit limits are managed with functions `setDepositsLimit()` and `setNftDepositsLimit()`. They set `depositsLimit` and `nftDepositsLimit` without zero input checks. Zero can be inputted either by mistake, or with the intention to disable limits.  ## Recommendations  We recommend requiring that the new value is not zero.
